content.short: xHashtag is a Web3 reputation protocol.
content.description: xHashtag is a Web3 reputation protocol that helps individuals build and display on-chain credentials. It simplifies collecting, organizing, and retrieving verifiable activity records across networks. The platform centers on a .soul domain name, which is also a soul-bound NFT, serving as a durable testament to a holder's on-chain activities. Beyond personal reputations, xHashtag enables projects to engage their communities by issuing SBTs in return.
